questions.question: Ritu sold two TV sets at Rs. 4,800 each gaining 20% on one and losing 20% on the other. Find out the total percentage gain or loss.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ritu sold two TV sets at Rs. 4,800 each gaining 20% on one and losing 20% on the other

**Formula used:**

 Profit = frac{{selling price - cost price}}{{cost price}}×100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the first TV be x.

Then, (4800-x)/(x)×100=20

Solving for x,

 x=(4800)/(1.2)=4000

Let the cost price of the second TV be y.

Then, (4800-y)/(y)×100=-20

Solving for y,

 y=(4800)/(0.8)=6000

Therefore, the total cost price is 4000+ 6000 = Rs. 10000 and the total selling price is 4800 + 4800 = Rs. 9600 

**∴ There is loss of (10000-9600)/(10000)×100=4\%**

questions.question: The marked price of an air conditioner is Rs. 45,000 and there are two successive discounts of 15% and 20% available on it. Find selling price of the air conditioner.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The marked price of an air conditioner is Rs. 45,000 and there are two successive discounts of 15% and 20% available on it. 

**Formula used:**

Selling price = (100 - discount ratio) × marked price

**Calculation:**

Selling price = (100-15)/(100)×(100-20)/(100)×4500=30600

**∴ The selling price of the air conditioner is Rs. 30600.**

questions.question: if arithmetic and geometric mean of x and y is 8 and 3√7, respectively, then the value of x³ + y³ is :
questions.solution:

Arithmetic means (A.M) = 8

Geometric means(G.M) = 3√7

**Formula Used:**

A.M = (a + b)/2

G.M = √(ab)

x³ + y³ = ( x + y )³ - 3xy(x + y)

**Calculations:**

According to the questions,

⇒ A.M = (x + y)/2

⇒ 8 = (x + y)/2

⇒ x + y = 16

⇒ G.M = √(xy)

⇒ 3√7 = √(xy)

On squaring both sides, we get

⇒ 9 × 7 = xy

⇒ xy = 63

Now,

⇒ x3 + y3 = (x + y)3 - 3xy(x + y) = (16)3 - 3 × 63 × 16 = 4096 - 3024 = 1072

**Hence, the value of x³ + y³ is 1072**

questions.question: If the average of P numbers is Q² and the average of Q numbers is P², then the average of (P + Q) numbers will be :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of the first group = P × Q²

Total sum of the second group = Q × P²

Combined sum of both groups = PQ² + QP² = PQ(P + Q)

Average of combined group = Combined Sum ÷ Total Count

Combined Average = PQ(P + Q) ÷ (P + Q) = PQ

**∴ The correct answer is PQ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Average of P numbers = Q²

⇒ Average of Q numbers = P²

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Count = P
 Avg = Q²
 Sum = PQ²

 +

 
 Count = Q
 Avg = P²
 Sum = P²Q

 

 
 Total Count = P + Q
 Combined Avg = Total Sum ÷ (P + Q)

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Average = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of the first group = P × Q²

⇒ Sum of the second group = Q × P²

⇒ Total Sum of (P + Q) numbers = PQ² + P²Q

⇒ Factoring out PQ from the algebraic expression:

⇒ Total Sum = PQ(Q + P)

⇒ Total Number of observations = P + Q

⇒ Combined Average = PQ(P + Q) ÷ (P + Q)

⇒ Combined Average = PQ

**∴ The correct answer is PQ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average Formula

When separate groups with given counts and averages are combined, the Combined Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Weighted Average

This type of average attaches a specific weight to each value based on frequency or importance. Formula: Sum(wᵢxᵢ) ÷ Sum(wᵢ).

Deviation Method for Averages

A trick for faster calculation: Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Total Count). This avoids large multiplications by observing shifts around a central assumed value.

If the difference between those who voted for candidate P and those who did not vote was 1000, the number of individuals eligible for casting a vote in that election was :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In an election, 35% of the voters voted for candidate P whereas 50% of the remaining voted for candidate Q. The remaining voters did not vote. The difference between those who voted for candidate P and those who did not vote s 1i000

**Formula used:**

x% of y = x/100 × y

**Calculation:**

Number of voters who voted for candidate P = 0.35x

Number of voters who did not vote = 0.5×0.65x = 0.325x

Then, 0.35x - 0.325x = 1000

Solving for x, 

x=(1000)/(0.025)=40000

**∴ The number of individuals eligible for casting a vote in that election was 40000.**

questions.question: Mahesh and Suresh can complete a work in 16 days and 12 days, respectively. Starting with Mahesh, they work on alternate basis. How many days will take to finalise the complete work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Mahesh can complete the work in 16 days

Suresh can complete the work in 12 days

They work on the alternative basis

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Time taken x Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work = LCM of 16 and 12 = 48 

⇒ Efficiency of Mahesh = Total work / Time taken = 48 / 16 = 3

⇒ Efficiency of Suresh = Total work / Time taken = 48 / 12 = 4

⇒ The total efficiency of both = 7 

We can say that,

⇒ In 2 days = 7 work is completed

⇒ 12 days = 42 work

For 13 days Mahesh has to work 

⇒ 13 days = 42 + 3 = 45 work

The remaining work has to complete by Suresh

⇒ Remaining work = 48 - 45 = 3

⇒ The remaining work is completed in = 3 / 4 days

⇒ Total days to complete the work = 13 + 3/4 = 13(3)/(4)

**Hence, The total work is completed in 13(3)/(4)** **days**

questions.question: If (a + b) = √11 and (a - b) = √7, then find the value of a² b² (a² + b²).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(a + b) = √11

(a - b) = √7

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ (a + b) = √11

Squaring both sides,

⇒ (a + b)² = (√11)²

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2ab = 11 ........ (1)

Similarly,

⇒ (a - b)2 = (√7)2

⇒ a2 + b2 - 2ab = 7 ........ (2)

Now, Subtract eq(2) from (1)

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2ab - (a2 + b2 - 2ab) = 11 - 7

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2ab - a2 - b2 + 2ab = 4

⇒ 4ab = 4

⇒ ab = 1

From the formula,

⇒ (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

⇒ a2 + b2 = (a + b)2 - 2ab = (√11)² - 2 x 1 = 11 - 2 = 9

According to the question,

⇒ a2 b2 (a2 + b2) = (1)² x 9 = 1 x 9 = 9

**Hence, The value of the above equation is 9**
